top_news.title: Asian Stocks Set for Gains as Tech Selloff Eases: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Asian equities were primed to rebound Friday after dip buyers powered a recovery on Wall Street from a chip-stock selloff fueled by concerns about the artificial intelligence trade. Treasuries rallied on haven demand and the dollar slipped.

top_news.title: MSCI Weighs Indonesia Downgrade, Removal From Global Indexes
top_news.summary: Indonesia faces a potential ejection from global stock indexes after MSCI Inc. said the country no longer merits emerging-market status, escalating the threat of foreign investor flight as concerns deepen over market integrity.

top_news.title: Harvard Fund Hits Record $68 Billion After 27% Annual Return
top_news.summary: Harvard University’s endowment jumped to a record $68 billion as successful bets on equities and venture capital including SpaceX holdings helped the richest US college weather an unprecedented pressure campaign from President Donald Trump.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Oct. 16
top_news.summary: Oil was set for a second weekly advance as increasing Middle East supply risks weighed against a fresh release of emergency reserves.

top_news.title: Texas Senate Race Will Come Down to Turnout, Says Siena's Levy
top_news.summary: Don Levy, director of the Siena Research Institute, said that while the Democratic party itself is not gaining in popularity, 'change' is what's on top of mind for voters, and 'they want their lives to be better' and see voting as a way to do that. Levy also discussed the fight for Latino voters in Texas and other sunbelt states and said that many voters believe that ICE tactics go too far.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Hot US Inflation, Treasury Safe Haven, CoreWeave's Credit Risk
top_news.summary: "Bloomberg Real Yield" highlights the market-moving news you need to know. Today's guests: Societe Generale Americas Head of Research Subadra Rajappa, Columbia Threadneedle Investments Global Head, Fixed Income Gene Tannuzzo, BoFA Securities head of US Credit Strategy Neha Khoda, and JPMorgan Asset Management Fixed Income Portfolio Manager Stephanie Doyle. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Ross Gerber on Tesla Roadster, Potential SpaceX Merger
top_news.summary: Ross Gerber discussed Tesla’s anticipated Roadster unveiling, following a Barclays note suggesting Tesla and SpaceX could merge before year-end, potentially ahead of Tesla’s annual general meeting. Gerber said a high-priced car made in low volumes would not materially affect Tesla financially. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: IEA Agrees to Release of Outstanding 100 Million Oil Barrels
top_news.summary: The International Energy Agency said that member countries agreed to complete the release of 100 million barrels of oil that are still outstanding from an intervention in March aimed at cooling high fuel prices.

top_news.title: Porsche CEO Leiters on New Luxury Supercar, China and EVs
top_news.summary: Porsche AG unveiled a concept previewing a new supercar, the Mission S, that will be positioned above the 911 in its lineup. Speaking with Matt Miller on "Bloomberg The Close," Porsche CEO Michael Leiters discusses the new supercar and also comments on the state of the China market, the future of electric vehicles and the German automaker's storied legacy. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Big Take: What Is the US Economy Trying to Tell Us?
top_news.summary: On today’s Big Take podcast, editors Matt Boesler and Cristina Lindblad join Sarah Holder to unpack what the data says is happening in the US economy and why consumer sentiment tells another story.  (Source: Bloomberg)
